model: Ratings v3 (game-recency RAPM EV + PP / PK, FIN, xG v2 target)

impact.baseline: position average (F / D): every per-60 rate centred on its TOI-weighted mean among rated roster skaters of the group

units.impact: goals per 82 games above an average player at his position (F / D): off_impact + def_impact
units.off_impact: goals per 82 games: EV offence + PP offence + finishing, each x his expected minutes
units.def_impact: goals per 82 games: EV defence + PK defence, each x his expected minutes
units.sd: posterior SD of impact (EV and PP / PK rating uncertainty; TOI and FIN taken as known)
units.ev_off: EV xGF/60 vs an average skater (higher is better)
units.ev_def: EV xGA/60 prevented vs an average skater (higher is better)
units.pp_off: PP xGF/60 vs an average PP skater (higher is better)
units.pk_def: PK xGA/60 prevented vs an average PK skater (higher is better)
units.fin: EV goals above xG per 60 from his own shots, shrunk (higher is better)
units.off: EV xGF/60 vs average (= ev_off, the v2 name)
units.def: EV xGA/60 prevented vs average (= ev_def, the v2 name)
units.toi: EV minutes, window seasons + this season
